sub_answers.sub_question: What disputes arose over representation of Bosnia's ethnic groups within the national team and football association?
sub_answers.text: Football in Bosnia became divided along ethnic lines during the war, with Bosnian Croats launching the Football Federation of Herzeg-Bosnia and its own league in 1993 and Bosnian Serbs organizing the First League of the Republika Srpska in 1993 [d55965203s4p0]. The Bosnian Football Association (N/FSBiH) competitions were effectively confined to territory under Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina institutions and were consequently Bosniak-majority, creating disputes over representation of the country's ethnic groups within national football structures [d55965203s4p0] [d63104390s1p0].

sub_answers.text: A hastily arranged Bosnia-Herzegovina team played humanitarian friendly matches in March 1993 while the Bosnian War was ongoing [d8582465s6p0]. The Bosnian national team began playing official matches in late November 1995 [d8582465s6p0].

Which disputes and controversies have occurred over ethnic representation (Bosniaks, Croats, Serbs) in Bosnia and Herzegovina’s national team selection, Football Association leadership, and allocation of club/region representation within the FA?
sub_answers.text: After the breakup of Yugoslavia football in Bosnia and Herzegovina split along ethnic lines with Bosnian Croats forming the Football Federation of Herzeg-Bosnia and a Croat-only league and Bosnian Serbs organising the First League of the Republika Srpska in 1993.[d55965203s4p0] The Bosnian Football Association (N/FSBiH) applied for FIFA and UEFA membership after independence but competitions under N/FSBiH auspices were largely suspended during the war and the N/FSBiH-aligned competitions had a Bosniak majority presence when activity resumed.[d55965203s4p0] The country’s post-war constitutional arrangements require political representation organized by the three constitutive peoples (Bosniaks, Croats and Serbs), reflecting the broader ethnic identity politics that have affected sports governance and representation.[d63104390s2p0]

sub_answers.text: During the Bosnian War football split along the same ethnic lines as the country, with Bosnian Croats forming the Football Federation of Herzeg-Bosnia and their own First League in 1993 where only Croat clubs competed [d55965203s4p0].
